# pulse_current_organization (Data Source)

Returns the Pulse organization derived from the configured automation credential. The caller cannot select another organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pulse_current_organization" "this" {}

output "pulse_organization_id" {
  value = data.pulse_current_organization.this.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pulse organization UUID.
- `name` (String) Organization display name.
- `slug` (String) Organization slug.
